## POLYGON 01 — offline Android build

Standalone, landscape-first concrete-room physics sandbox. The APK is signed with the standard Android debug key so it can be installed directly for testing.

- Minimum Android version: Android 6.0 (API 23)
- Target: Android 15 (API 35)
- Package: `dev.arena.polyground`
- Network access: none; Three.js, Cannon-es and all game assets are bundled inside the APK
- Controls: left virtual stick to move, swipe on the right to look, large action button to pick up / throw / strike; on desktop preview use WASD, mouse and E

On the phone, download `Polyground-Android.apk`, open it, and approve Android's one-time "Install unknown apps" prompt if asked.
